goals.description: Sub-goals produced by the Goal Decomposer (03_goal_decomposer).

id.description: Unique identifier for the goal within this graph.

category.description: Goal category. Aligns with sub-goal classes called out in the architecture (model choice, data prep, compute plan, validation strategy).

owner_agent.description: Identifier of the agent/module responsible for this goal (e.g. "04_method_discovery").

acceptance_criteria.description: Free-text acceptance criteria for declaring this sub-goal complete.

edges.description: Directed edges expressing dependencies between goals.

source.description: ID of the source goal (the prerequisite).

target.description: ID of the target goal (depends on source).

category.description: Edge semantics. seq = strict ordering; parallel = no ordering preference; conditional = guarded by a predicate.

condition.description: Predicate string when category is conditional; ignored otherwise.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp at which the GoalGraph was produced.

source_intent_id.description: Identifier of the upstream IntentSpec this graph was decomposed from.

rationale.description: Brief explanation of why this decomposition was chosen.
